title: Till Ceilings and Short-Tender Charges on the Employee Meal Account Plans
content:
Every till in a Larkspur Table cafe or micro market reads two ceilings and three overdraft figures off the plan the Employee Meal Account is held on. They are printed here plan by plan.

- The single transaction ceiling is the most one till transaction may come to.
- The daily ceiling is the most the account may spend across all tenders in one service day.
- The overdraft limit is how far below zero stored value may go on a single till transaction; the overdraft charge is what is raised when a till transaction takes the balance below zero; and the monthly overdraft count is the number of overdraft charges the plan raises in one calendar month.

| Meal plan | Single transaction ceiling | Daily ceiling across all tenders | Overdraft limit on one transaction | Overdraft charge | Overdraft charges in one calendar month |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | $25.00 | $45.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | $35.00 | $60.00 | $15.00 | $3.50 | 3 |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | $30.00 | $55.00 | $25.00 | $3.00 | 3 |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | $24.00 | $40.00 | $10.00 | $2.50 | 2 |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | $20.00 | $32.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | $120.00 | $180.00 | $150.00 | $0.00 | 0 |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

Take an account on the Subsidized Daily Allowance Account plan. A $24.00 ticket sits exactly at that plan's single transaction ceiling of $24.00 and is within it; a $24.50 ticket is above it. Across a service day the same account may spend $40.00 in total, so three $13.00 meals come to $39.00 and stay inside the daily ceiling while a fourth would not. The same plan carries an overdraft limit of $10.00, an overdraft charge of $2.50 and a ceiling of 2 overdraft charges in a calendar month.

Against that, the Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account prints $0.00 overdraft limit, $0.00 overdraft charge and 0 overdraft charges a month, while the Executive Dining Charge Account prints a $150.00 overdraft limit with a $0.00 charge and 0 charges a month.
